_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Native harness: `claude plugin eval` with tool_used graders; the evidence rules below map onto tool_used input_match. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I want to open my project's ai-docs folder in Obsidian. Can you check that the notes are linked together properly and fix whatever is broken?
these markdown files are a mess, half of them aren't linked from anywhere. make an index and link them up so I can browse them in obsidian
write down what we learned this session about the Unity build error before you finish
build a knowledge graph of this codebase so I can ask which modules depend on the renderer
lint the markdown folder at <fixture> for obsidian: broken links, orphans, missing index files. write any missing index files and tell me what is left for me to decide
expectations: vault_lint.py ran on the fixture (trace) and an INDEX.md now exists in the fixture's notes/ folder; the reply reports before and after counts, not just 'done'
evals.baseline: without the skill a fresh session greps for links by hand or writes an ad hoc script, rarely writes the index, and often recommends wikilinks

evals.prompt: convert the wikilinks in <fixture> to links that also work on GitHub, then confirm nothing is broken
expectations: after the run, `vault_lint.py <fixture>` reports no broken wikilinks and only the ambiguous [[Beta]] left as a wikilink; the reply names that ambiguous link and the deliberate broken nope.md link for the user instead of guessing
